AI Video Editor in Chennai — Edit and Export Local Videos (v1.0.0)

- Launches an AI-powered video editor for Chennai users, enabling quick, professional editing without learning complex software.
- Supports uploading raw video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) for cloud-based automatic editing.
- Allows users to trim footage, add Tamil and English subtitles, and export polished reels within 1–2 minutes.
- No account required: Free token (100 credits, 7-day validity) generated on first use.
- Designed for content creators and small business owners seeking fast, professional edits with simple instructions.
- Exports in formats optimized for social media, with optional batch and iterative editing workflows.
